beats.say: A safety razor sells itself. And you never buy the razor again.
Buy a razor and a set of blades together.
Buy only the razor, no blades included.
Buy a razor plus a subscription of blades.
Buy a razor and a single spare blade.
First year: 51 razors, 168 blades sold. Looks lopsided.
But it does a job - the razor is a loss leader.
The razor price is tiny; the blade sales skyrocket to 123,648 in year two.
Each razor buyer becomes a blade customer forever.
So the profit lives in the blade column, not the handle.
Barber: $30 handle only, $45 handle + blade pack, $70 premium kit - the pack feels like the smart buy.
Café: $8 reusable cup, $12 cup + refill plan, $20 premium set - the refill bundle wins because it includes the consumable.
If the first thing is cheap, the real cost is hidden later. Follow for more.
